title: Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator
content: Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator. We'll provide character design concepts. You'll create high-quality, commercial-use illustrations with poses and backgrounds. Quality level matching the attached characters. Requirements: - Japanese anime art style (see attached images) - Experience with 2D game character art - Faithful to the original design (hair, outfit, colors). To apply: Send your portfolio. Feel free to reach out!

title: Looking for artist to turn me, man and pup into Pokemon characters
content: Looking for an artist who can turn me my man and my pup into pokemon characters! TIA! Don’t really have a budget, willing to pay anything for great art! Contact via comments or DM on the post.
